title: Tinning
summary: TIN'NING, participle present tense [from tin.] Covering with tin or tinfoil. TIN'NING, noun The act, art or practice of covering or lining any thing with melted tin or with tinfoil, as kitchen utensil

inlines.v: TIN'NING, participle present tense [from tin.] Covering with tin or tinfoil. TIN'NING, noun The act, art or practice of covering or lining any thing with melted tin or with tinfoil, as kitchen utensils, locks, bits, etc.
